messages:
Ivy (Design): quick microcopy pass — two tiny items: the chart tooltip and the delete confirmation for API keys. Short but can reduce support chatter.
Omar (Product): go ahead. what's wrong with the tooltip?
Ivy (Design): tooltip currently: 'Latency vs throughput'. propose: 'Latency (P50) vs throughput (requests per second)' and tooltip body: 'Hover a point to see sample size and latency at P50 and P95.' makes metrics consistent with other pages.
Dee (Engineering): agree. also avoid 'req/s' abbreviation so screen readers read it clearly.
a11y-bot: ensure chart points expose aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip text and that keyboard users can focus points.
Ivy (Design): done — updated copy; will add guidance for accessible hooks in the PR description.
Ivy (Design): second item: Delete API key modal. Current copy: 'Delete key?' with body 'This will remove access.' users asked if historical logs or dashboards break.
Sam (Support): customers confused whether past activity still shows. they worry about audit trails.
Omar (Product): we should explicitly say logs remain and dashboard history is unaffected. Also offer a short cooldown/undo like 10 seconds.
Dee (Engineering): implementable. propose modal copy: heading 'Delete API key' body 'Deleting this key will revoke its ability to make new requests. Existing logs and historical dashboards will remain. You can undo this action for 10 seconds.' Buttons: 'Cancel' and danger 'Delete key'. Add aria-label 'Confirm delete API key'.
a11y-bot: good. ensure focus lands on Cancel and dialog has role="alertdialog" with aria-labelledby/aria-describedby.
Ivy (Design): I'll add the copy and screenshot to the PR comment.
Omar (Product): approved. updating release notes: 'Clarified chart tooltip and API key deletion modal to reduce ambiguity.'
Dee (Engineering): opening PR with copy + a11y hooks and undo snackbar text.
Ivy (Design): thanks! i'll review the PR and test keyboard + screen reader flows tomorrow.
